name: The Viper
source:
The protagonist is a low-level manager waiting for a promotion who falls in love with his colleague Nicole. But what could go wrong? Suddenly his school bully appears. Will the protagonist be able to keep his job, will his beloved girlfriend remain faithful to him? It depends on the player...​

[From F95Zone]
translation:
主角是一位等待升职的基层经理，他爱上了同事妮可。但可能会出现什么问题呢？突然，他的校霸出现了。主角能否保住工作，心爱的女友能否继续忠于他？这取决于玩家…​

[来自F95Zone]
